summary: FG Nexus Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a reduction in executive compensation due to a smaller digital asset business, alongside disclosure of ongoing share repurchase programs. Through June 5, 2026, the company repurchased approximately 2,984,212 common shares (35% of pre-buyback outstanding) at an average ~$13.62/share, and 264,465 Series A Preferred shares (30% of outstanding) — no fixed price, premium, or board recommendation cited. Capital return is purely a buyback; no advisor named. Watch for execution pace and impact on float, especially given reduced scale of operations.
